B. It assesses collective progress towards achieving the purpose and long-term goals of the Paris Agreement.
C. It occurs every five years under the Paris framework.

questions.explanation_english: The Global Stocktake is a fundamental mechanism under the Paris Agreement aimed at evaluating collective global progress every five years towards achieving long-term climate objectives. questions.explanation_english: Under Sustainable Development Goal 15, the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification serves as the main international instrument addressing land degradation and drought. This framework promotes sustainable land management and soil restoration worldwide.
